integrity: All-order formulas are proved analytically; two independent exact-integer finite enumerations check all frequencies through cycle length seven. No independent mathematical validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Single simple cycles of length at least three; exactly three additive colours. The exact Fourier formula and rank do not establish an extension to larger palettes or graphs with multiple cycles. Historical-priority comparison is bounded; an unindexed equivalent vertex-weighted chromatic result remains possible.
title: A modulo-three resonance law for the complete ternary Fourier spectrum of cycle colourings
